alt: A white card with a grid of square window icons and the words Weight and Style sits next to a blue W tile stacked on dark blue sheets, with dotted window grids scattered nearby.
caption: A conceptual display of window design tools with a large letter W resting on a stacked gradient of blue tiles.
description: Several stylized physical objects rest on a white dotted surface. To the left, a white card features various square grid icons and labels for Weight and Style. A blue, square tile marked with a white letter W sits prominently atop a fanned stack of dark blue sheets, while smaller dotted grid patterns are scattered to the right.
